description: Answers a verify task from get_open_work: confirm when the source states the fact as shown, dispute when it states something else. Needs a source URL and the words you copied from it. Website, phone and hours only. A confirmation is stored for a person to read, and it does not change the fact or its check date. A dispute also opens a suggestion. Needs Authorization: Bearer <agent key>. With no key, your person can paste this at https://littlemilwaukee.com/contribute.

date_verified.description: The day you read the source page, as YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: For a dispute, what the source states instead, up to 500 characters.

quote.description: The words on the source page that support this, copied exactly, up to 1,000 characters.

result.description: confirm when the source states the fact as shown, dispute when it states something else.

source_url.description: The page you checked, ideally the business's own website.

task_id.description: The verify task id from get_open_work.

name: submit_verification
